newsitem.title: USA: ACNielsen gets contract from Kmart.
newsitem.headline: ACNielsen gets contract from Kmart.

text.p: ACNielsen Corp said Tuesday it signed a multi-year contract with Kmart Corp to be the primary information provider for the retailer's Consumables Product Division.

ACNielsen said it will help Kmart develop an information warehouse to support category management work. Along with its Scantrack data for food, drug and mass merchandise channels, ACNielsen will offer its Homescan National Household Panel information.
The contract also encompasses ACNielsen consulting services including category analysis templates, data validation, and applications, as well as assistance in Kmart's training programs.
As part of the new contract, ACNielsen said, it will now have available for manufacturers and brokers all store data for the entire Kmart and Super Kmart stores within the United States.
ACNielsen, with 1995 revenues of $1.3 billion, provides market research, information and analysis to the consumer products and service industries.
